because: The surfaces of the three verifiable negatives of ADR-0056 D5. A negative holds only when the diff touches none of its surface; any contact makes it unverifiable, and the pull request does not declare it (the line is optional, so a wide surface costs nothing: widen rather than refine). Read by tools/quality/check-pr-negatives.ts at the MERGE BASE of the pull request, never from its head. Every pattern is a regular expression over the repository-relative path, compiled case-insensitively, and every name and content marker is compared case-insensitively.

workflow.because: A path added or type-changed at or under the directory is a workflow added (a rename is an addition: the list is read with --no-renames). A symlink at or under .github, added or modified in the diff or present in either tree, can make GitHub read any target as a workflow or action.

schema.because: Names: the .schema suffix in JSON or YAML (320 tracked .schema.json paths over the 22 unarchived libre-ai repositories on 2026-10-23, fixtures excluded), the bare schema.json|yaml|yml, and any JSON or YAML file under a schema/ or schemas/ directory. Content, deliberately wide and failing closed: a raw byte search, no parse, any case, for `schema`, an escape opener (backslash u, backslash x), a backslash followed by LF or CR (a YAML double-quoted scalar folds `"$sch\` + newline + `ema"` into $schema; valid JSON never has it), and in .json5 any backslash (identity escapes such as `\s`, line continuations). A file that merely says schema, or escapes anything, is a contact, and the author does not declare the negative.

dependency.envFiles: Measured on 2026-10-24 with Bun 1.4.4-canary.1: a BUN_CONFIG_REGISTRY or NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY pointing at 127.0.0.1:9 in .env, .env.local or .env.production makes `bun install` fail with ConnectionRefused to that address; .env.development and .env.test are read when NODE_ENV names them; .env.example is not read, even with NODE_ENV=example (the default registry answered). Hence every .env and .env.* is on the surface except .env.example.
dependency.ciReaders: Data files CI reads to fetch and run other code, with their readers: .github/composition/manifest.json — .github/workflows/validate-composition.yml:74 and :120 run .github/composition/run-composition.py, which reads it (:23) and fetches each pinned ref (:301); ecosystem/fleet-pins.v1.yaml — .github/workflows/fleet-bump.yml:68 reads the latest generation with tools/fleet/added-generations.ts (:21), and :70 replays that generation's manifest with .github/composition/check-generation-coherence.py, which installs the composed targets (:61); ecosystem/repositories.v1.yaml — .github/workflows/fleet-advisories.yml:40 runs tools/security/check-fleet-advisories.ts, which reads it (:57) and clones each repository (:224) to run cargo-deny on it, and .github/workflows/inventory-drift.yml:123 runs ecosystem/check-sql-construction.ts, which reads it (:279) and clones each repository. Measured with `git grep -lE '"ref"|"repository"' -- '*.json' '*.yaml' '*.yml'` and the readers of each hit. Not added: .github/dependabot.yml (read by the Dependabot service and by a conformance check, not executed by CI), the policy and exception registers (ecosystem/work-package-policy.v1.yaml, ecosystem/release-age-exceptions.v1.yaml), evidence and projections (they record, nobody fetches from them).
dependency.because: What is covered, and nothing more. By name: the manifests, lockfiles and workspace files of npm, Bun, pnpm, Yarn, Deno, Cargo, uv, Poetry, PDM, pip, Go, Bundler, Composer, Nix, Maven and Gradle; the registry and package-manager configurations (.npmrc, .yarnrc*, bunfig.toml, pip.conf, pip.ini, uv.toml, .pnpmfile.cjs, Plug'n'Play loaders, import maps); the version files (.tool-versions, .nvmrc, .node-version, .python-version, mise.toml, rust-toolchain*); every action.yml|yaml; .gitmodules. By path: *requirements*.txt|in, requirements/, constraints*.txt, PEP 723 locks (*.py.lock), pylock*.toml, the Gradle version catalog and wrapper, .cargo/, .yarn/, the tooling pins of this repository (*.pin.json, toolchains/ — dependencies of the tooling in the sense of ADR-0056 D4), node_modules/, vendor/, third_party/, patches/, Dockerfile*, Containerfile*, every *.lock (uv's `<script>.lock`), .python-versions, .env and every .env.* except .env.example (see envFiles), the data files CI reads to fetch and run code (.github/composition/, ecosystem/fleet-pins.v1.yaml, ecosystem/repositories.v1.yaml — see ciReaders), and the workflow and action directories where `uses:` lives. By content: ANY file added or modified carrying a PEP 723 block (`# /// script`), whatever its extension. By mode, in the gate's logic: any gitlink, any symlink, and a symlink in either tree whose path or path-as-a-directory is on the surface. Any status counts, both sides of a rename included.
